name: Herringbone and Chevron in Mercer Island Homes: Sanding Patterned Floors
title-tag: Sanding Herringbone & Chevron Floors: Mercer Island Guide
meta-description: Herringbone and chevron refinish beautifully — if nobody drum-sands them like straight flooring. How we sand pattern floors, from a Mercer Island contractor.
post-summary: January 18, 2027 · Pattern floors carry grain in two directions, so any straight sanding pass cross-cuts half the boards. How we refinish Mercer Island’s herringbone and chevron: diagonal roughing, the directionless Lägler TRIO for finishing cuts, the stain trade-off nobody mentions — at the same $3.99/sq ft.
